status: declared before candidate warm timing and match queries
hypothesis: In-check quiescence already searches every legal evasion; using that loop to detect mate avoids a redundant existence test without changing search choices. Non-check stalemate checks, rule50/mate precedence and maximum-ply legality checks remain intact.

generation.partition: Frozen shuffled parent first128 for30ms regression, next32 for100ms regression, last128 for conditional rating. Exclude three development datasets, five opening suites, the144-opening rating parent and the208-opening deferred-capture parent.

behavior: 160 fresh positions with exact full depth8 traces;256 additional seeded retained-history/FEN/rule50/warm-cache/searchmoves/node-limit cases. Independent legal PV checks. No combining deferred-capture and evasion candidates.
correctness: 51 C# tests including terminal/mate/rule50 at ply126/127 and deterministic stop/undo inside an evasion; required independent legality/perft/protocol verification.
profile: Same moves/scores/depths/nodes at five depth9 positions; fewer legal-move existence calls. Profile timing is diagnostic only; mating nodes may score pseudo-moves before proving no legal evasion.

timing.method: Same persistent engines, alternating role order per position/pass, reset game/TT per position but matching retained history. Require exact work and full PV. No other heavy jobs during timing.

uncertainty.primary: Resample first-four-legal-ply families, retaining both colors and all pairs within each sampled family. Unresolved0/1 bounds retained.

promotion: Engineering optimization only when all correctness/behavior/tactical/profile gates pass, median warm speed gain>=5%, both match scores>=0.5 and family lower bounds meet the declared thresholds; zero forfeits/unresolved. Otherwise keep opt-in and preserve ordinary behavior. Never call this Stockfish superiority or infer Elo from speed/regression.

conditional_rating.model: R=2300+400*log10(score/(1-score)), explicitly local SF19 strength-setting equivalent; prior calibration already fixed the reference setting.
conditional_rating.numeric_gates: All576 requested games audited, no confirmation unresolved games/forfeits, finite primary interval width<=200 and point/interval within1320..3190. Same20k bootstrap/declared seed; suppress point for unresolved. Attach rating only to the exact matched candidate. Public Elo remains unestablished.

decision: Preserve exact source/binaries/options/hardware/time controls/openings/reports/PGNs, failed test-harness build logs and all gate results. Earlier production and rating artifacts remain intact. Full-strength then-current Stockfish superiority across controlled resources/controls remains the unachieved project goal.
